notes.en:
**Summary and General Analysis**

✦ Fu Xuan's Skill activates a Zone, increasing the whole team's Max HP and CRIT Rate. Most of the damage taken by allies will be transferred to Fu Xuan while this Zone is active. Additionally, Fu Xuan will grant one chance to resist to Crowd Control debuff to all allies once per Skill usage.

✦ Her Talent passively decreases damage taken by all allies. If she ever falls below 50% health, Fu Xuan will consume 1 Charge, and recover most of the lost HP.

✦ An outdated character who will struggle to sustain for high difficulty endgame content. She however is perfectly fine for casual play. If using her for high difficulty content, it is recommended to get S1 She Already Shut Her Eyes.

**Investment Priority**

**S1 > E1 > E2**

**Investment Explanation**

✦ She Already Shut Her Eyes is needed for Fu Xuan to sustain comfortably because it solves her Energy needs, while allowing her to use an HP% rope.
This gives her a much more comfortable Max HP pool to work with, so that she can absorb more damage without getting killed.

**Ability Rotation**

Skill > Basic > Basic

or

Skill > Basic > Skill > Basic
